scripts.test: pnpm -w exec vp test run --project core
scripts.test:watch: pnpm -w exec vp test watch --project core
scripts.test:related: pnpm -w exec vp test run --changed --project core
scripts.test:ui: pnpm -w exec vp test watch --ui --project core
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm -w exec vp test run --project core --coverage
scripts.coverage: pnpm -w exec vp test run --project core --coverage
scripts.bench: pnpm -w exec vp test bench --run --project core --reporter=verbose
